About This Tracker

This site tracks new and updated mods for Baldur's Gate 3 across PC and console (PlayStation & Xbox).

How It Works

The tracker automatically checks mod.io every hour for new mods and version updates on every supported platform.

Features

  • New Mods — Freshly added mods on any platform
  • Updated Mods — Existing mods that received version bumps
  • Platform Filter — Filter the feed by PC or Console
  • Daily Navigation — Browse changes by date
